content.text:
Tasting note:
Ripe blackberry and cassis lead, framed by toasty oak and firm, fine-grained tannins. Long, layered finish with graphite and dried herbs. Impressive now; will reward a decade in the cellar.

anyOf.description: Simple and sound - correct, plain, forgettable

anyOf.title: everyday
anyOf.description: Pleasant everyday wine - some appeal, little depth

anyOf.description: Good - clear varietal character, well made

anyOf.description: Very good - balanced, with something to say

anyOf.description: Excellent - complex and structured

anyOf.title: outstanding
anyOf.description: Outstanding - depth and length, built to age
